title: Projektetage Affiliation Abbreviation Morph
description: Universities on projektetage intro leave big empty space when morphing to abbreviations (LUH, UdK). Fix so they abbreviate in place without reserved full-name width.
summary:
Fixed university affiliation lines leaving empty space when morphing to abbreviations (LUH, UdK) on projektetage intro.

Root cause: reveal.js matched `data-id` on the full-name morph ghost (`w-full`), so the animated box kept the long university width while the abbreviation rendered in a separate element.

Fix: put `data-id` and `presentation-morph-into` on the abbreviated label; keep the prior full name as an absolute fade-out ghost without `data-id`. Tightened `.presentation-affiliation-line-part` to `width: max-content`.

63 renderer + 39 core tests pass.
